articles.title: TB 26-09 Measured Hammer-Tap Inputs
articles.summary: For more information, contact Joel W. Sills, Langley Research Center, joel.w.sills@nasa.gov . An instrumented hammer test does not require an idealized single half-sine waveform. When the complete force and response are measured accurately, crest ripples and separated contacts remain known inputs. Force shape changes excitation, but does not inherently invalidate the record. Adequacy depends on measurement accuracy, bandwidth, signal-to-noise ratio, and coverage of the test objective.

articles.title: NASA’s Hubble Uncovers Case of Missing Oxygen in Nearby Dwarf Galaxies
articles.summary: NASA’s Hubble Space Telescope just revealed a mystery in our cosmic neighborhood. In a paper published Monday in The Astrophysical Journal, researchers using Hubble studied 37 nearby dwarf galaxies — small galaxies containing a few thousand to hundreds of millions of stars — and found that much of the oxygen they expected to see is missing. Simulations predict that significantly more oxygen, a tracer of a wider set of heavy elements, should reside in these galaxies. So where did it go?

articles.title: CubeSat achieves challenging laser link to ground
articles.summary: This milestone represents Greece's first optical link with a low Earth orbit (LEO) satellite. Unlike conventional radio-frequency communications, optical links use narrow laser beams to transmit data. This enables high data rates, but it also makes establishing and maintaining a connection technically demanding. The beam must be directed precisely towards a receiver while the satellite moves through orbit at several kilometres per second. Both terminals must acquire the signal and continuously track one another during a limited communication window. Not only that; atmospheric conditions add more complexity as clouds can block the link entirely and turbulence can degrade signal quality.

Contrairement aux communications radiofréquences classiques, les liaisons optiques utilisent des faisceaux laser étroits pour transmettre des données. Cela permet des taux de données élevés, mais il rend aussi l'établissement et le maintien d'une connexion techniquement exigeante. Le faisceau doit être dirigé précisément vers un récepteur tandis que le satellite passe par orbite à plusieurs kilomètres par seconde. Les deux terminaux doivent acquérir le signal et se suivre en continu pendant une fenêtre de communication limitée. Non seulement cela; les conditions atmosphériques ajoutent plus de complexité que les nuages peuvent bloquer entièrement le lien et la turbulence peut dégrader la qualité du signal.

articles.summary: North-central Pennsylvania is canyon country with an Appalachian flair. Pine Creek Gorge reaches depths of about 1,500 feet (460 meters) along its gently curving path through the forests of the Allegheny Plateau . In autumn, greens give way to a palette of reds and golds sought out by leaf peepers. articles.summary: Explanation: What color is the Moon? It depends on the night -- and the time. Outside of the Earth's atmosphere , the dark Moon , which shines by reflected sunlight, appears a magnificent ly brown-tinged gray. The featured image highlights a collection of apparent colors of the full moon on Earth, documented by one astrophotographer over 10 years from different locations across Italy . A red - or yellow -colored moon usually indicates a moon seen near the horizon . There, some of the blue light has been scattered away by a long path through the Earth's atmosphere , sometimes laden with fine dust. A blue-colored moon is more rare and can indicate an atmosphere carrying larger dust particles .

articles.title: Celebrating BepiColombo, three words at a time

articles.summary: Now on a three-month, million-mile journey to its final orbit, NASA’s Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope will soon reveal the universe’s darkest secrets. The mission launched at 7:26 a.m. EDT on Aug. 30 aboard a SpaceX Falcon Heavy rocket from Launch Complex 39A at the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida.
articles.title_fr: Allumer le voyage de Roman
articles.summary_fr: Maintenant sur un voyage de trois mois, des millions de miles vers son orbite finale, le télescope spatial romain Nancy Grace va bientôt révéler les secrets les plus sombres de l'univers. La mission a été lancée à 7h26 HAE le 30 août à bord d'une fusée SpaceX Falcon Heavy du complexe de lancement 39A de l'agence Kennedy Space Center en Floride.

articles.title: August Lunar Eclipse Rises Over Louisiana
articles.summary: A lunar eclipse is visible over southern Louisiana. The lunar eclipse was visible throughout much of North and South America and part of Europe and Africa between Aug. 27-28. The Full Moon slipped through Earth’s shadow on Aug. 27, continuing into Aug. 28 for some parts of the world, resulting in the lunar eclipse. At maximum eclipse, the Moon takes on a dramatic dark, ruddy or coppery tint along the covered edge. New Orleans is home to NASA’s Michoud Assembly Facility, where stages for NASA’s SLS (Space Launch System) rocket and structures for Orion spacecraft are produced for the Artemis missions.
articles.title_fr: Août Éclipse lunaire se lève sur la Louisiane
articles.summary_fr: Une éclipse lunaire est visible au-dessus du sud de la Louisiane. L'éclipse lunaire a été visible dans une grande partie de l'Amérique du Nord et du Sud et dans une partie de l'Europe et de l'Afrique entre le 27 et le 28 août. La pleine lune a glissé à travers l'ombre de la Terre le 27 août, continuant jusqu'au 28 août pour certaines parties du monde, entraînant l'éclipse lunaire. À l'éclipse maximale, la Lune prend une teinte sombre, rugueuse ou cuivrée le long du bord couvert. La Nouvelle-Orléans abrite l'installation d'assemblage Michoud de la NASA, où sont produites des étapes pour la fusée SLS (Space Launch System) de la NASA et des structures pour les engins spatiaux Orion pour les missions Artemis.

The Observatorio Astrofísico de Javalambre is a world-class astronomical observatory located within the path of totality.
